refusals.CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND: No such campaign in your agency.
refusals.PUBLIC_CODE_ALREADY_EXISTS: That public code is already used by another campaign.
refusals.CAMPAIGN_LABEL_ALREADY_EXISTS: That campaign name is already used.
refusals.INVALID_STATE: The campaign's current state does not allow this action.
refusals.POLICY_NOT_SET: Set the selection policy before publishing.
refusals.POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT: The policy changed while you were editing. Reload it and try again.
refusals.POLICY_HASH_MISMATCH: The policy you reviewed is not the current one. Reload it and try again.
refusals.POLICY_CATEGORY_COVERAGE_MISMATCH: The policy must cover every target category, and only those.
refusals.INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE: Every target district needs an active session before publishing.
refusals.STALE_COVERAGE: The session list changed since you reviewed it. Reload and try again.
refusals.INVALID_CAPACITY: The session capacity is not valid.
refusals.CAPACITY_DECISION_REQUIRED: An unlimited session needs an explicit unbounded-capacity decision.
refusals.SESSION_ALREADY_RESERVED: That session already has reservations and cannot be changed this way.
refusals.SESSION_CONFLICT: That session conflicts with an existing one.
refusals.INVALID_SESSION_DATE: The session date is outside the examination window.
refusals.INVALID_REPORTING_HOUR: The reporting hour is not valid.
refusals.DISTRICT_PROVINCE_MISMATCH: That district is not in the chosen province.
refusals.CAMPAIGN_WRITE_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this campaign at the same time. Reload and try again.
refusals.UNKNOWN: The campaign service refused this action.
refusals.FORBIDDEN: Your post is not allowed to do this.
refusals.GENERIC: The request could not be completed. Nothing was changed; try again.

campaigns.replayed: This was already done: the original result is shown.
campaigns.noPermission: Your post does not allow this action.
campaigns.frozen: The campaign is published: its structure is frozen and can no longer be changed.

studio.notFoundBody: No campaign with this code exists in your agency.

list.title: Recruitment campaigns
list.lead: All campaigns of {{agency}}, in every state.

empty.title: No campaigns yet
empty.body: Create the first campaign of your agency. It starts as a draft and is not visible to citizens until you publish it.

new.title: New campaign: the basics
new.lead: Step 1 of 4. This creates a draft. Then you set the selection policy, the district sessions, and publish.
new.kigaliTime: All times on this screen are Kigali time (UTC+2).

hints.publicCode: Capital letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 64 characters. Citizens see it; it cannot change.
hints.targetDistricts: Each district needs one session before you can publish.
hints.walkIn: Only where the agency’s walk-in policy allows it.
hints.phones: Separate several numbers with commas (at most 10).

errors.publicCode: Use 3 to 64 capital letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.labelTooLong: The name is longer than 50 characters.
errors.categoryAgency: A category does not belong to your agency.
errors.registrationWindow: Registration must close after it opens.
errors.examinationWindow: The examination cannot end before it starts.
errors.examBeforeRegistrationCloses: The examination cannot start before registration closes.
errors.reportingHour: Enter a whole hour from 0 to 23.
errors.intake: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
errors.website: Enter a full http or https address.
errors.walkIn: Your agency’s policy does not allow walk-in.
errors.venue: Enter the venue name (at most 200 characters).
errors.sessionOutsideWindow: Choose a day inside the examination window.
errors.capacity: Enter a capacity of at least 1.

basics.title: Basics
basics.lead: The basics are fixed when the draft is created. To change them, cancel the draft and create a new one.

policy.title: Selection policy
policy.lead: Step 2 of 4. Each save creates a new immutable version with its own SHA-256 hash. The platform supplies no official thresholds: confirm every value against the official announcement.
policy.none: No policy version yet. Publishing needs one.
policy.suggestionNotice: Values shown as “suggestion” are copied from the eligibility engine. They are a starting point, not the official policy: confirm each category against the official announcement.
policy.suggestion: Suggestion: confirm against the official announcement
policy.documentsHint: Only document types your agency accepts are offered.
policy.legalBasisCodeHint: A code such as the instrument’s number. The rehearsal uses {{example}}.
policy.legalBasisReferenceHint: The announcement or instrument this policy follows (at most 256 characters).
policy.diffFirst: No earlier version was saved from this device: every field is new.
policy.diffBasis: Compared with the last version you saved from this device.
policy.incomplete: {{count}} items still to complete or confirm.
policy.noChanges: No change from the last saved version.
policy.localMatch: Verified on this device: the hash matches the policy you sent.
policy.localMismatch: Warning: the hash does not match the policy computed on this device.
policy.localUnavailable: This browser cannot compute the hash for a local check.

sessions.title: District sessions
sessions.lead: Step 3 of 4. One session per target district: venue, examination day, reporting hour and capacity. An unlimited capacity is an explicit, recorded decision.
sessions.coverage: Coverage: {{covered}} of {{total}} districts have an active session
sessions.unboundedHint: Sends the explicit decision UNBOUNDED_CAPACITY, which is audited.

publish.title: Preflight and publish
publish.lead: Step 4 of 4. Check that everything is ready, review what citizens will see, then publish by typing the public code.

checks.draft: The campaign is still a draft
checks.coverage: Every target district has an active session ({{count}} missing)
checks.capacity: Every session has a valid capacity ({{count}} invalid)
checks.windows: The dates are coherent ({{count}} sessions outside the examination window)

publish.confirmBody: Publishing makes the campaign visible to citizens and opens registration.
publish.consequenceFrozen: The policy and the sessions are frozen: they can no longer be changed.
publish.done: Campaign {{code}} is published and open for registration.

preview.walkIn: Walk-in registration is possible on exam day.

confirm.typeCode: To confirm, type the public code {{code}}.

lifecycle.title: Close, complete or cancel
lifecycle.lead: Each action changes the campaign’s state for everyone and cannot be undone. Counts come from the live administration read.
lifecycle.terminal: This campaign is {{state}}: no further action is possible.

close.title: Close registration for {{code}}?
close.body: Citizens will no longer be able to register.
close.effect: Registration closes now, ahead of the planned date if it has not passed.

complete.title: Complete {{code}}?
complete.body: Use this once the recruitment exercise is over.

cancel.title: Cancel {{code}}?
cancel.body: A draft, or an open campaign without applications, can be cancelled.
cancel.effect: The campaign is withdrawn for good.
cancel.applications: The server refuses the cancellation of an open campaign that already has applications.
